pages: Tane, ten, short black hair, in a red swim vest and navy shorts, sits on a concrete seawall winking, one bare foot over the edge. Middle distance: a striped beach towel, one chipped enamel mug. Background: white sea on grey water and the Opotiki headland. Bright windy daylight on wet concrete.

Tane, ten, short black hair, in a red swim vest and navy shorts, comes up at the tiled pool wall with his mouth open, one hand on the white tile edge. Middle distance: the lane rope, a black towel on the wall. Background: the long blue lane under high windows, bright indoor light.

Tane, ten, short black hair, in a red swim vest and navy shorts, swims the lane again with one hand dragging one red-and-white float of the lane rope, eyes screwed shut. Middle distance: black lane markings on the pool floor, a stopwatch on the rail. Background: the far tiled wall, flat ceiling light.

Tane, ten, short black hair, in a red swim vest and navy shorts, stands in grey shallows with sand in his hair, wiping his mouth with the back of his hand. Middle distance: rippled sand under clear water, one pair of sandals on the beach. Background: the open sea and a low grey sky, flat windy light.

Tane, ten, short black hair, in a red swim vest and navy shorts, bends over a white kitchen sink wearing one old pair of swimming goggles with a cracked strap, face in the basin. Middle distance: a chrome tap, a bar of soap. Background: a kitchen window with the blind half down, soft indoor light.

Tane, ten, short black hair, in a red swim vest and navy shorts, crouches at the sink with the cracked strap over his eyes and the tap running onto his face, counting on his fingers. Middle distance: a steel benchtop, a soap dish. Background: the kitchen window, warm indoor light.

Tane, ten, short black hair, in a red swim vest and navy shorts, sits on a bench beside the pool with one white card in his hand and one blue pencil. Middle distance: swimming caps on the wooden bench, a stopwatch. Background: the still lanes and high windows, flat indoor light.

Tane, ten, short black hair, in a red swim vest and navy shorts, stands at the pool edge with his face wet, one hand flat over his own shut eye. Middle distance: one pair of goggles in his other hand, a black towel on the rail. Background: the lanes and the tiled wall, bright ceiling light.

Tane, ten, short black hair, bare to the waist in navy shorts, sits on a wooden bench in the changing room with one eye shut and elbows on his knees. Middle distance: one small mirror on the wall, a wet towel on the bench. Background: lockers and a high window with the afternoon in it, cool light.

Tane, ten, short black hair, in a red swim vest and navy shorts, holds one white card out to the poolside desk with one finger under the last line. Middle distance: a stopwatch on the desk, a stack of cards. Background: the pool and a lane rope, bright ceiling light.

Tane, ten, short black hair, in a red swim vest and navy shorts, drops one white card into his black kit bag standing on the tiled steps. Middle distance: the shallow steps into the green water, a folded towel on the rail. Background: the pool windows and flat daylight, the lane still.
